newsitem.title: LATVIA: FIRST VENTSPILS PUBLIC OFFER SET FOR JULY.
newsitem.headline: FIRST VENTSPILS PUBLIC OFFER SET FOR JULY.

text.p: The first round of public offers for shares in oil terminal Ventspils Nafta will take place in July, Latvian Privatisation Agency (LPA) legal director Viktor Shadinov said on Wednesday.
He said that in the first round some 10 million shares will be sold to private persons and legal entities for privatisation certificates.
"We plan to have the first stage of the public offer for July," Shadinov told Reuters.
The second stage will take place in September and October when only private persons will be able to buy shares for certificates, he added.
Shadinov said the idea of the second stage was to make sure that as many people as possible got Ventspils shares and the maximum amount to be sold to one person will be 100 shares.
"No Latvian citizen can theoretically have more than 100," he said.
The third stage of the public offer will see the remaining shares if any sold in the same way as the first round.
It is likely that Ventspils shares would appear on the stock exchange after the public offer has taken place.
